headline: Your Child's New Dental Home
sub: At Glen Eagle Pediatric Dentistry, we know kids! That’s because we specialize in treating children of all ages and those who have different needs. Our goal is to create the most comfortable atmosphere for our families. Here we will treat every child with compassion, and always.

offerings.title: Professional Gentle Care
offerings.body: Glen Eagle Pediatric Dentistry provides a “dental home” for your child, a place where oral health care is delivered in a comprehensive, accessible, and family-centered way. This relationship gives your child the best chance for optimal oral health. Our approach to dentistry focuses on prevention and education. We also focus on educating ourselves on the most current dental techniques and offer modern solutions when dental treatment is beneficial.

offerings.title: Meet Our Team
offerings.body: Our team at Glen Eagle Pediatric Dentistry strives to make each dental experience positive and create a nurturing environment for all of our patients. We aim to educate the whole family to help prevent dental problems and parents are welcome to be with their children during their appointments. Our goal is for our office to be a place where families are comfortable and look forward to visiting.

offerings.title: First Visit
offerings.body: I believe that every child deserves a positive dental experience and that getting to know and trust their dentist can play a lifelong role in healthy oral care. Our goal at Glen Eagle Pediatric dentistry is to build a relationship with your child.

featureBody: I love working with kids! After receiving my Masters of Public Health from West Chester University, and my DDS from New York University, I chose pediatric dentistry as my specialty. It is incredibly rewarding to help children have fantastic first experiences at the dentist and being part of their lives. I cannot wait to meet you and your child, and partner.
